label: USGS Water → TAK
info:
River and stream gauges: gauge height and flow at every active USGS site in Tennessee (plus a small buffer).

Data: USGS Water Services (https://waterservices.usgs.gov/). Updates every 15 minutes.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Set a contact email in the User-Agent header of the USGS request node (USGS asks for one).
3. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/usgs-water
